title: IPEDS 2024 Institutional Characteristics: Directory information (HD2024)
publisher: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics
lineage: downloaded by the Fetch institution registries workflow
notes: in scope: PSET4FLG = 1 (Title IV postsecondary universe)
scope: Title IV postsecondary institutions in IPEDS (PSET4FLG = 1): 50 states, DC and US territories; active = ACT A/N/R with no closing date. Closed, merged and out-of-universe institutions are kept with that status.
manifest_notes: User estimate was 5,626; IPEDS HD2024 has 5,799 active Title IV institutions (about 5,660 in the 50 states and DC, the rest in US territories). Difference: estimate likely excludes territories and uses an earlier year.
